# Gurbani World

> Gurbani World is the official website of the Gurbani World Android app by Singh Tech: a Sikh spiritual and learning platform with daily Hukamnama Sahib, Nitnem Banis, a Gurbani library, Waheguru Simran Mala, Sikh history and educational resources. The app is available free on Google Play.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://gurbaniworld.netlify.app/): Overview of Gurbani World and the Android app
- [About](https://gurbaniworld.netlify.app/about): Vision, mission and the team behind Gurbani World (Singh Tech)
- [App Features](https://gurbaniworld.netlify.app/features): All app modules, including Daily Spiritual Updates, Nitnem (30+ Banis), Gurbani Library, Simran Mala, Sikh Learning, Audio & Video, and Spiritual Personalities
- [Sikhi Learning](https://gurbaniworld.netlify.app/learning): Sikh History, the Ten Sikh Gurus, 52 Hukamas, Nanakshahi Sikh Calendar, Learn Punjabi and FAQ
- [Gurbani World App](https://gurbaniworld.netlify.app/app): App screenshots and the official Google Play download link
- [About This App](https://gurbaniworld.netlify.app/about-app): Purpose and feature overview of the Android app
- [Contact](https://gurbaniworld.netlify.app/contact): Feedback, Seva inquiries and official channels

## Policies

- [Website Privacy Policy](https://gurbaniworld.netlify.app/privacy): Privacy policy for this website
- [App Privacy Policy](https://gurbaniworld.netlify.app/app-privacy-policy): Privacy policy for the Android application
- [Terms and Conditions](https://gurbaniworld.netlify.app/terms): Terms for using the website and its educational resources

## Optional
